application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
-****COMMUNAL TREES***


T6	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Southwest corner of site, behind hedge, on boundary with Broom Close - Establishing Sycamore saplings / suckers with dead and decayed limbs / stems, at base of larger tree - Fell and poison establishing Sycamore saplings / suckers as unwanted basal sucker.		

T11	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Overhanging tennis court, dead hanging branch and sparse looking crown - 30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to tidy and contain and retain furnishing growth, and limit overhang to tennis court.
Final height 14m, final spread 10m.		

T12	Weeping Willow (Salix babylonica)	By swimming pool - Decaying pollard stems - Pollard approx 0.5m below the previous pollard points, removing approximately 5m new growth. Final height 5m and final spread 6m.		

T16a	Horse Chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum)	Opposite No.10 - Decay pocket seen at 7m in central crown and growing close to neighbouring property - Reduce away from corner of neighbouring property to give 2m clearance. Final height = 10m and final spread = 7m		

no number	Ash (Fraxinus excelsior)	2 x trees on south side of Thameside Road, near to T20, saplings growing through chainlink fence - Fell as low as possible as in poor location and damaging fence

T22a	Holm Oak - Evergreen Oak (Quercus ilex)	Group of trees growing on south side of Thameside Road near junction with Broom Road, branches very close to street light - Reduce away from street light to give 2m clearance. Final height = 13m and final spread = 8m.
